name: trellis-upgrade
title: Upgrade vendored Trellis 0.6.7 to 0.6.14
description: File-swap upgrade of the vendored Trellis scripts from 0.6.7 to 0.6.14, verified safe because the pack's .trellis/scripts tree is byte-identical to the 0.6.7 release templates with no local patches; delivers the task.py create base-branch seed fix observed live during this consolidation, the statusline UTF-8 stdin fix, journal merge=union, and machine-readable task.py --json output which pack wrappers that currently parse console prose should adopt.
creator: sdelmas
